name: Extnify Discount Rules for WooCommerce
author: extnify

sections.description:
Extnify Discount Rules lets you lower your WooCommerce prices with rules instead of editing every product by hand. Create a rule like “10% off everything” or “$5 off for members on weekends”, and the reduced price is shown on the shop, the product page and the cart.

Unlike a coupon, there is no code to type — the discount applies by itself. Unlike a cart fee, it changes the actual product price, so shoppers see the lower price (with the original struck through and a sale badge) while they browse.

Read the documentation » | Try the live demo »

What you can do with Extnify Discount Rules

  • Reduce every product’s price by a flat amount or a percentage.
  • Show the discount as a real sale — original price struck through, with WooCommerce’s sale badge.
  • Limit a rule by customer group, day of the week, date range and time of day.
  • Show an “Offer ends in…” countdown on time-limited offers.
  • Ignore WooCommerce’s own sale prices so your rules are the single source of truth.
  • Create as many rules as you need and enable, disable, copy or bulk-save them from one screen.

How it works

  1. Create a rule and enter the amount — a plain number for a fixed value off (e.g. 5), or a trailing % for a percentage (e.g. 10%).
  2. (Optional) Choose when it applies — customer group, days, a date range, a time window.
  3. The reduced price appears on the shop, category and product pages and carries through to the cart.

The free version applies a rule to all products in your store — ideal for store-wide offers. To target specific products, categories, brands or attributes, see Extnify Discount Rules Pro below.

Flat or percentage off

Enter a plain number for a fixed amount off, or add a trailing % for a percentage. Tick Show as sale to display the reduced price as a WooCommerce sale, so it looks consistent with your theme.

Conditional eligibility

Each rule only applies when the cart matches the conditions you set. The free version gates discounts by:

  • Customer group — guests, logged-in customers, or specific roles.
  • Day of the week — e.g. weekends only.
  • Date range — a start/end date for a seasonal sale.
  • Time of day — a start/end time window.

When several conditions are set, the rule applies only when all of them match.

Catalog display

The discounted price shows with the original struck through and a sale badge — exactly like a native WooCommerce sale. You can turn the badge off, and show an “Offer ends in…” countdown on products whose offer has an end date.

Live debugging

When a discount doesn’t apply and you’re not sure why, turn on the built-in debug log. For each rule it reports whether its conditions passed or failed and the resolved amount — so you can see exactly which condition filtered it out. The log is stored in your own database (never a file, never sent anywhere) and can be cleared with one click.

Works everywhere WooCommerce does

Prices are reduced server-side, so totals stay correct on both the classic and the block (Store API) cart and checkout. Catalog sale styling follows your theme.

Built for speed and privacy

  • No external requests and no tracking — every rule and calculation runs on your own store.
  • Lightweight — no bloat, no third-party libraries pulled in on your storefront.
  • Translation-ready — ships with a .pot file and a clean extnify-discount text domain.
  • Clean uninstall — deleting the plugin removes its table, option and log; nothing is left behind.

Need more? Extnify Discount Rules Pro

Extnify Discount Rules Pro adds:

  • Target discounts by product, category, brand or attribute (any / only / except modes).
  • Tiered “buy more, save more” pricing — by quantity, product price, line total or stock level.
  • Cart-total (Order) discounts — a single discount line on the cart, with percentage bases and caps.
  • Maximum cap and price rounding.
  • Import / Export your rules between stores.

Your free rules carry over automatically — Pro shares the same data.

More plugins by Extnify

  • Extnify Offer Rules — selectable discounts and optional add-ons for the cart and checkout. Free · Pro
  • Extnify Fee Rules — add conditional fees or discounts to the WooCommerce cart and checkout. Free · Pro
  • Extnify Shipping Rules — build your own conditional WooCommerce shipping methods and rates. Free · Pro

Extnify Discount Rules is built by Extnify, the team behind the X-Discount extension for OpenCart.
sections.installation:
1. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  2. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  4. Go to WooCommerce → Extnify Discount Rules and set Module Status = Enabled in Global Settings.
  5. Click Add New Method, enter the discount amount, and (optionally) restrict it by customer, day, date or time. Save, and the reduced price appears across your catalog and cart.
sections.faq:
Does this change the product price, or add a separate line?

In the free version it changes the product price — the reduced price shows on the catalog and in the cart. (A single cart-total discount line is a Pro feature.)

Will the discounted price show on the shop and product pages?

Yes. Flat and percentage discounts are applied to the price, so they show on the shop, category and product pages with a strikethrough and sale badge.

Can I discount only certain products or categories?

Not in the free version — a free rule applies to all products. Per-product, category, brand and attribute targeting is in Extnify Discount Rules Pro.

Can I give a quantity / bulk discount?

Bulk (“buy more, save more”) and other tiered discounts are a Pro feature. The free version offers flat and percentage discounts.

Does it work with the WooCommerce block checkout?

Yes. Prices are reduced server-side, so totals are correct on both the classic and block (Store API) cart and checkout.

Does this send any data anywhere?

No. Extnify Discount Rules makes no external requests and collects no data — everything runs on your store.

Can I upgrade to Pro without losing my settings?

Yes. Extnify Discount Rules and Extnify Discount Rules Pro share the same data, so your configured rules carry over automatically.
